title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
lineage: transferred by Matt Smith, mastered by Monte Barry. MAC tapes > Nak BX300 > Apogee Mini Me > Mini DAC (monitoring/mastering) > Lynx One soundcard > Wavelab 5.0 > 24/96 FLACs > Samplitude Pro 7.22 > TLH > CD Tag
source: taped by Monte Barry, Nakamichi 550 portable stereo cassette recorder, taped with Dolby NR on Maxell UD C90 normal bias cassettes, Sony ECM-99 single-point stereo mic, mic is mounted on a 12-foot pole, FOB.

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience recording with clear separation, but the show features unusually short jams and missing material
ai_review.review: The audience tape is praised for its superior clarity and instrument separation compared to other sources, making it a solid primary source despite some missing sections. Musically the performance is described as professional yet atypical for the era, with most songs staying under ten minutes and no standout moments highlighted.

ai_rating.rationale: Recording quality is rated highly by reviewers while the musical performance is viewed as competent but lacking the long jams fans expect, leading to an overall mid‑high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note excellent separation and clarity versus other sources; no major distortion or balance issues mentioned, though the tape is missing some portions of the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusually short song lengths for this period (few tracks over ten minutes); overall professional performance but lacking the extended jams typical of the era.
